card.name: Discard and dosing-instruction wording
card.fires_on: Words in dosage and preparation instructions, mostly 'discard(ed)' after 'unused portion', and words such as 'adult', 'morning', 'once', 'day' and 'diluents' in dosing directions.

modes.label: Discard unused portion
modes.description: The word discard or discarded in instructions about single-use vials and unused solution.
modes.example: Vials are for single dose only. Disc<<ard>> any unused solution.

modes.label: Dose schedule words
modes.description: Words giving who or when in a dosing statement, such as adult, morning, once, or time of day.
modes.example: is one 60 mg capsule daily in the<< morning>>.
